subject: updateCheckboxGroupInput : use without 'choices'; possible select/unselect all

messages.author: aee3e25f4c0afac7
messages.subject: updateCheckboxGroupInput : use without 'choices'; possible select/unselect all
parts:
I wanted to make it easier for a user to manage a large checkboxGroupInput() with a select/unselect all feature, which as it stands require an observe() with an updateCheckboxGroupInput(). Ideally there would just be an option to have the checkbox group with an argument that allows this (much like DataTable has an option for a search bar). This is especially helpful when the options were dynamically generated to avoid having to recalculate the options to tell Shiny which to select.

Short of this, updateCheckboxGroupInput not requiring the choices would also be helpful, as, if the values are known to be within a certain integer range, at least the labels wouldn't be needed and the 'selected' argument could simply be an integer vector encompassing the known range.

parts: Actually, it appears that the updateCheckboxGroupInput does work without the choices specified - either that was always the case or it's changed since the post claiming it didn't was written. Would still be nice to have a select/unselect all feature for the checkbox group though.
